notes: Waw before the servants rendered with (rule 14); and as soon as is one rendering of a single waw (rule 55), headed on the coordinator; have goes to the possessive לְ since the verb אוֹר is rendered by the noun light (rule 43), its suffix unrepresented because the one ye belongs to הִשְׁכַּמְתֶּם; unrendered apodosis waw before depart unrepresented.
